bio: The name says it all: it is all about high-quality dry-aged beef from Austria and Nebraska, served as a variety of exquisite cuts. Whether you choose tenderloin, bone-in rib-eye, bone-in New York strip, T-bone or porterhouse, exceptional quality of meat and perfectly cooked steaks are guaranteed. Be sure to sample the wonderful house-made steak fries. Tip: The light-filled atrium with its lovely arched ceiling is especially delightful. The restaurant is housed in the same building as Boutique Dom Hotel building, in the centre of Graz....
